metadata.session_type: Founding trace of a subtraction profile: reading order, first rulings, ISA-shaping discoveries, deliverable 1, three-way amanuensis correspondence

rulings.ruling: Master pinned to PTSG-CPU-Formation 2026-09-03 revision; subtraction judged on the resulting form, not the path
2,083 clocks vs 2,048 bins per sample period per module; the 35-clock margin is the meaningful quantity; quotients are not; N per module is a design variable
ISA speaks integers (16- and 32-bit external formats); Q-conventions are program-tier, owned by WPMS Ch.3
RESTRICT F-F13 (ADRS as STA destination) — first Fixed
Layer vocabulary: L1 pipeline / L2 Formation (this profile) / L4 Formation (external, verification tool first)
exp() placement: both options presented with deliverable 3
Ownership split: ISA-visible register map = profile; Q-interpretation, wiring, L1 internals = WPMS Ch.3
Two-stage Stay-value register (StayVal.s by WSV; StayVal.p loaded at Stay Set, presented to the Core); 12-bit; packet length = Stay value
Program-owned MAC shift: SHV register written by WSH (mode 3 sub-op 3); MAC/MUL realign by >> SHV
Post-commit shadow inheritance (F-F14) adopted profile-side now
EW2: WSV value 0 or > NMAX (2048) -> Error HALT; EW3: STM into inbox -> Error HALT

discoveries.title: The Stay is the packet
discoveries.content: k of the difference engine is the Stay counter output at clock rate; packet length = Stay value. The Core's external Stay-value input is live until the trailing edge (decrease below counter -> extra lap), so the freeze promised by F-F4 is realized Formation-side by a two-stage register. The Core's convention (internal operand 0 selects the external value) is INT-R1's register-source bit already in silicon.

discoveries.title: An integer ISA must let programs own the shift
discoveries.content: Raised by the master's amanuensis on F-T7. Resolved by SHV/WSH. The master's first program re-issued with 'LDA #28; WSH' validates CLEAN on the profile contract with identical numerics; without those lines it overflows on every MAC.

deliverable_1.block: N, TAG, A0, AR1, AR2, E0, PH0, PHD1, PHD2, OM0, OMD1, OMD2, CUR (+3 reserved)

customer_answers_2026-09-07.C3-D1: WPMS boundary carries phase-domain integers only; Hz never crosses it
